/etc/systemd/system/crowdbastion-static-.text:
[Unit]
Description=CrowdBastion static non-dynamic firewall rules
After=local-fs.target
Before=crowdsec-firewall-bouncer.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B /usr/local/lib/crowdbastion-static-policy/apply.py
RemainAfterExit=yes
UMask=0077
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

/etc/crowdsec/bouncers/crowdsec-firewall.text:
mode: iptables
iptables_chains: []
iptables_v4_chains:
- INPUT
- FORWARD
iptables_v6_chains:
- INPUT
- FORWARD

/etc/sysctl.d/99-zz-crowdbastion-network.text:
# CrowdBastion owned selected TCP defaults; earlier assignments remain reported.
net.ipv4.tcp_syn_retries = 6
net.ipv4.tcp_synack_retries = 5
net.ipv4.tcp_orphan_retries = 0
net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout = 60
net.ipv4.tcp_autocorking = 1
net.ipv4.tcp_no_metrics_save = 0
net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse = 2

/etc/crowdsec/acquis.d/crowdbastion-real.text:
source: journalctl
journalctl_filter:
- _SYSTEMD_UNIT=forwardx-realm-both-53534.service
- _SYSTEMD_UNIT=forwardx-realm-both-53536.service
- _SYSTEMD_UNIT=forwardx-realm-both-53537.service
labels:
  type: realm-forwardx

/etc/crowdsec/parsers/s01-parse/20-realm.text:
name: local/realm-forwardx-observation
description: ForwardX realm diagnostics only; never extracts source_ip or emits decisions
filter: "evt.Line.Labels.type == 'realm-forwardx'"
onsuccess: next_stage
grok:
  pattern: '^.*?\[%{YEAR:realm_year}-%{MONTHNUM:realm_month}-%{MONTHDAY:realm_day}\]\[%{TIME:realm_time}\]\[%{DATA:realm_module}\]\[%{LOGLEVEL:realm_level}\](?:\[%{WORD:realm_protocol}\])?%{GREEDYDATA:realm_message}$'
  apply_on: Line.Raw
statics:
  - meta: log_type
    value: realm_forwardx_observation
  - meta: service
    value: realm
  - meta: realm_level
    expression: evt.Parsed.realm_level
  - meta: realm_module
    expression: evt.Parsed.realm_module
  - meta: realm_protocol
    expression: evt.Parsed.realm_protocol
